title: Give Me 10 Minutes and I’ll Teach You How to Raise $100K - This Year
actionable_recommendations: Conduct a full audit of current fundraising efforts and position in the sector.
Perform a competitive analysis to identify unique strengths and gaps.
Create a donor persona to focus fundraising efforts on the right audience.
Build a case for support outlining your organization’s impact and appeal to potential donors.
Choose campaign strategies based on donor preferences rather than trends.
claims_requiring_current_verification: 70% of US nonprofits operate on annual budgets under $50,000.
Hope for Kids raised $75,000 on their first ask using the FAST system.
Lakewood University raised over $70,000 in three months after implementing the FAST campaign.
intended_organization_or_user: Nonprofit organizations seeking to improve fundraising success.
major_ideas: Many small nonprofits struggle due to a lack of foundational work before fundraising.
Creating a clear plan and understanding your donors leads to higher fundraising success.
Building a fundraising system creates sustainable income instead of one-time donations.
prerequisites: Clarity in your organization's mission and goals.
Understanding of your nonprofit's positioning relative to competitors.
proposed_workflow: Step 1: Foundation - Audit current efforts and perform competitive analysis.
Step 2: Action - Launch a focused fundraising campaign using insights gained from foundation steps.
Step 3: Systems - Develop an annual fundraising plan that aligns activities and deadlines.
Step 4: Traction - Maintain momentum by continually building systems and making strategic investments.
tools_templates_resources: Trello board for visualizing the fundraising plan.
Click & Pledge as an all-in-one fundraising platform.
